LanguageData.RS_DescResize: Change the field size by 2 tiles. Larger fields need more power.
LanguageData.RS_DescPresets: Choose one of the predefined rectangular sizes.
LanguageData.RS_DescOffset: Shift the field relative to the generator by 2 tiles.
LanguageData.RS_DescMode: Switch between protecting the whole area or only the perimeter wall.
LanguageData.RS_DescReset: Reset size, offset and mode to their defaults.
LanguageData.RS_DescOverlay: Show or hide the field outline.
LanguageData.RS_DescFixedSize: This Mk I generator has a fixed field size. Use Mk II or Mk III for adjustable fields.
LanguageData.RS_DescFit: Follows the exact shape of all gravship hull plates. ANY layout works: L, U, T, rings with courtyards, branching ships and separate decks. Turn off to size the field manually.
LanguageData.RS_DescPadding: Expands the hull shape outwards by N tiles in every direction (shape is preserved). 0 = exactly the plates. Click to cycle 0-4.
LanguageData.RS_SettingsOverlay: Show a faint outline for all active shields
LanguageData.RS_SettingsFriendlyPods: Mk II/Mk III also block friendly and neutral drop pods
LanguageData.RS_SettingsDebug: Write debug messages to the log
LanguageData.RS_SettingsPower: Mk II/Mk III power per cell multiplier: {0}
LanguageData.RS_SettingsHint: Changes to the power multiplier apply within a second. Field sizes are limited by each generator definition.
